line_items.reasoning: Q4 actual revenue came in at a record $18B vs. guidance of ~$17.4B, exceeding the prior quarter's raised target by ~$600M (~3.4% upside).
AI semiconductor revenue of $6.5B (up 74% YoY) exceeded the guided ~$6.2B (up 66% YoY), with the custom accelerator business more than doubling YoY.
Infrastructure software revenue grew 19% YoY in Q4, outpacing the guided ~$6.7B / +15% YoY reaffirmation from the prior quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA margin came in at 68%, above the guided 67%, and gross margins held better than the guided ~70 bps sequential decline, despite higher XPU and wireless mix.

The $73B+ AI order backlog and record Tomahawk 6 bookings reinforce an acceleration materially above the prior 50–60% YoY growth rate, consistent with and arguably exceeding the raised FY2026 AI outlook described last quarter.
